articulation.label: milk
articulation.alt: milk: /m/ → /ɪ/ → /l/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
